title: IPC admin.peers.list params
description: Which page of the dial gate's per-peer rows (2.2). `after` is the last peer of the previous page, EXCLUSIVE, and absent for the first; a position in the ascending order of the peers' canonical strings, not a row, exactly as `trust-list-params` is. Pages are read against the live gate and are not a snapshot. CONNECTIVITY.md §19, A 2026-10-06.
